items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 2 at 10:57PM PDT until October 3 at 10:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...In Oregon, Clatsop, Tillamook, Lincoln, and Lane County
Coasts. In Washington, Pacific County Coast.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down and leave plenty of distance ahead of you.
Pedestrians and cyclists should wear bright or reflective clothing to
increase the chances of being seen by others in poor visibility
conditions.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 2 at 11:01PM PDT until October 3 at 12:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog will reduce visibility to 1 NM or less.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...Until noon PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility will make navigation difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coverage of dense fog will be lower beyond
40 NM from the coast.
items.instruction:
If you must navigate, proceed with caution. Use proper fog
signals. Make sure all running lights are on. Remember to use
your radar and compass.
